english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately waving a weapon to threaten or show off.

examples.english: They brandish a knife in the street, frightening everyone into leaving at once.
examples.traditional: 嗰個人喺街上揮舞把刀，嚇到大家即刻走晒。
